critical_behaviors: Isolate configuration, sessions, state, credentials, and profile-scoped runtime discovery.
Update locking and archive path rejection preserve the installed runtime and user state.
Loopback binding, session boundary isolation, and workspace routing remain correct.
Extensions retain credential and profile boundaries; skill prose remains runtime input.
Shared gateway and billing contracts typecheck for every UI consumer.
Desktop boots, reaches its isolated local backend, renders a mocked turn, and reports startup failures without user state or permission changes.
TUI build and tests preserve session identity and streamed turn behavior.
Dashboard runtime and shared gateway adapters preserve scoped sessions.
Unknown, failed, cancelled, and missing validation cannot be reported as passing.
